name: imposition-toolkit
description: Client-side PDF imposition & pre-press toolkit — 90 print-production tools, 156 ready-made industry templates and 69 production-recipe workflows (all also shipped as data: dist/catalog.mjs + templates.json + recipes.json). Covers booklets, n-up, cards, labels, folding, large-format, tickets, marks, dielines, cut-contour spot toolpaths, white/varnish, braille, QR/Code128/DataMatrix/EAN-13 barcodes, file backdrops, true-shape sticker nesting, collating/gathering/OMR/lay/fold bindery marks, CSV data-merge + QR, colour effects/management, edit + JDF/CIP4 export, layers, optimize/decrypt/repair — running entirely in the browser via pdf-lib. Framework-agnostic engine + optional React 19 UI with a dark theme.

scripts.build: esbuild src/impose.ts --format=esm --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/impose.mjs && esbuild src/catalog.ts --format=esm --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/catalog.mjs && tsc src/pdfjs-worker-url.d.ts src/impose.ts src/catalog.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --skipLibCheck --moduleResolution bundler --module esnext --target es2020 --outDir dist && node scripts/emit-catalog-json.mjs
